summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new Forms module nested inside Workspaces. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%), all frontend UI features verified via Playwright.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates - Returns templates list with is_admin flag
Backend: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates - Auto-seeds Maintenance Request Form on first access
Backend: POST /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates - Admin can create new template with name, description, fields
Backend: PUT /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates/{id} - Admin can update template
Backend: DELETE /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates/{id} - Admin can delete template and its submissions
Backend: POST /api/workspaces/{id}/form-submissions - Submit a filled form with responses dict
Backend: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/form-submissions - Admin sees all submissions, filter by template_id works
Backend: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/form-submissions/{id} - Get single submission detail
Backend: Non-member cannot submit forms (403 returned)
Backend: All 6 field types supported (text, textarea, date, number, yesno, dropdown)
Frontend: 'Forms' tab visible in workspace detail page (between ICT Support and Members)
Frontend: Templates list shows Maintenance Request Form card with 6 fields
Frontend: 'Fill Out' button visible on template cards
Frontend: 'Submissions' button visible on template cards
Frontend: Admin sees '+ New Template' button
Frontend: Admin sees 'Edit' and 'Delete' buttons on templates
Frontend: Form builder shows Form Name and Description inputs
Frontend: Form builder has all 6 field type buttons (Text Input, Text Area, Date, Number, Yes/No, Dropdown)
Frontend: Fill Form view shows submitter info (name and email)
Frontend: Fill Form view renders all 6 form fields with data-testid attributes
Frontend: Submissions table shows 'Submitted By', 'Email', 'Date', 'Actions' columns
Frontend: Submissions table shows existing submission with View and Delete buttons
seed_data_creation: Maintenance Request Form auto-seeded with 6 fields (date_submitted, staff_name, repair_location, behavior_concern, priority_level, repair_description). Test submissions created and cleaned up during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Forms module is fully functional. Backend routes at /app/backend/routes/forms.py handle templates and submissions CRUD. Frontend component at /app/src/components/workspace/WorkspaceForms.jsx renders templates list, form builder, fill form view, and submissions table. Forms tab is registered in WorkspaceDetailPage.jsx. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_workspace_forms.py covers all Forms endpoints. Field types supported: text, textarea, date, number, yesno, dropdown.
